Our client is seeking a results-driven Digital Marketing Manager (B2B) to lead and scale the company’s marketing strategy across paid, organic, outbound, and brand channels.

This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution and is ideal for a growth-minded marketer who thrives in fast-paced environments, understands modern B2B marketing trends, and can drive measurable pipeline and revenue impact.

The Digital Marketing Manager will own the full marketing funnel — from demand generation and lead nurturing to brand positioning and performance optimization — ensuring consistent growth, high-quality lead flow, and strong brand visibility.
The ideal candidate is analytical, creative, execution-focused, and comfortable balancing strategy with day-to-day campaign management.
q: Proven experience in B2B marketing leadership roles such as Head of Marketing, Growth Lead, or Senior Marketing Manager
Demonstrated success driving measurable growth through paid ads, outbound marketing, SEO, and organic channels
Strong understanding of modern B2B marketing tools and platforms including LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, Meta Ads, HubSpot, analytics tools, and outbound systems
Experience balancing strategic planning with hands-on execution
Strong analytical mindset with experience interpreting performance data and optimizing campaigns accordingly
Excellent leadership, communication, and project management skills
Experience leading marketing functions in B2B service-based, SaaS, or professional industries
Background in account-based marketing (ABM) or performance-driven demand generation
Familiarity with CRM and automation platforms such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or Marketo
Experience managing cross-functional marketing teams or external agencies
Strong branding, storytelling, and positioning capabilities
Experience scaling marketing systems in high-growth environments
What Does a Typical Day Look Like?
A Digital Marketing Manager’s day is a mix of strategic planning, campaign execution, and performance analysis. You will:
Review campaign dashboards and optimize active marketing initiatives
Collaborate with leadership, sales, and content teams to align priorities and messaging
Launch and refine campaigns across paid and organic channels
Monitor lead flow, pipeline quality, and funnel conversion performance
Test new acquisition ideas, audience segments, creatives, and messaging strategies
Analyze campaign data and prepare actionable reports and recommendations
In essence: you are responsible for driving pipeline growth, strengthening brand visibility, and ensuring marketing efforts generate measurable business impact.

d: Lead City Operations assurance of testing, commissioning and integrated verification for fire and life safety systems before asset handover, activation and opening. The role establishes witness-test strategy, verifies performance against approved design intent and acceptance criteria, and provides an evidence-based readiness recommendation for complex Qiddiya City assets.
q: Bachelor degree in Fire Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Building Services or related discipline.
Postgraduate qualification in fire engineering, systems engineering or commissioning is desirable.
Professional engineering registration or membership of IFE, CIBSE, IET, SFPE or equivalent preferred.
Relevant commissioning, fire alarm, suppression, smoke-control or functional-safety certification desirable.
Detailed knowledge of NFPA 3, 4, 13, 20, 25, 72, 92 and applicable SBC/Saudi Civil Defense requirements.
Integrated testing, cause-and-effect verification, fault diagnosis, commissioning documentation and deficiency management.
Ability to interpret drawings, schematics, network architecture, sequences, calculations and manufacturer data.
Strong leadership, safe systems of work, evidence management, technical reporting and stakeholder coordination.
Minimum 7 years of relevant fire/life-safety systems, commissioning or test engineering experience, including 5 years in a leadership role.
Leadership of testing and commissioning on complex mixed-use, high-rise, transport, entertainment, industrial or giga-project assets.
Demonstrable experience of integrated systems testing, handover assurance and managing defects through successful retest and close-out.
Saudi Arabia or GCC delivery experience and authority interface strongly preferred.
r: Develop risk-based inspection and test plans identifying hold points, witness points, prerequisites, acceptance criteria and required records.
Lead witnessing of fire detection and alarm, voice alarm, suppression, fire pumps, fire water, smoke control, emergency power, emergency lighting, fireman systems and specialist interfaces.
Plan and direct integrated system tests demonstrating cause-and-effect sequences across fire alarm, access control, lifts, HVAC, smoke control, BMS, CCU monitoring and mass notification.
Verify approved drawings, calculations, method statements, test scripts, device schedules, cause-and-effect matrices and commissioning records before witnessing.
Confirm test equipment calibration, competent personnel, safe test conditions and effective impairment and isolation controls.
Record test results, defects, failed criteria and retest requirements with auditable evidence and clear ownership.
Assess partial completion, temporary arrangements and residual defects; define interim controls and escalation thresholds.
Provide evidence-based go/no-go and handover-readiness recommendations without displacing project, contractor or statutory accountabilities.
Maintain the FLS testing and commissioning assurance register, including system status, outstanding tests, defects and close-out evidence.
Coordinate test programmes with projects, operators, vendors, commissioning agents, CCU, security, facilities management and emergency-response teams.
Undertake sampling and quality surveillance of contractor pre-commissioning and commissioning activities.
Verify O&M manuals, as-built records, asset registers, training, spares, warranties and system ownership before handover.
Capture lessons learned and standardise witness-test templates, scripts and evidence requirements across the portfolio.
Coach FLS engineers and support Saudization and competence development.
Comply with Qiddiya governance, HSE, confidentiality, document-control and delegated-authority requirements.
Prepare technical reports, readiness dashboards and executive briefings; escalate critical life-safety risks promptly.
Promote safe testing, professional challenge, collaboration and continuous improvement.
City Operations FLS; Development and Delivery; Engineering; Asset Management; Facilities Management; HSE; Security; CCU; Digital/ICT; venue and asset operators.
Saudi Civil Defense and third-party authorities/certifiers.
Main contractors, specialist subcontractors, system manufacturers, commissioning agents, consultants and independent testing laboratories.
